stops.name: Wupper river
stops.quote: The area stretches from Cologne (west) to the Sauerland (east) or from the Wupper river (north) and to the Sieg river (south).
stops.english: The area stretches from Cologne (west) to the Sauerland (east) or from the Wupper river (north) and to the Sieg river (south).
